questions.question: At which ground did Boland record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Boland Park, Paarl — largest win by runs of 533, against Kei on 2011/01/29.

questions.question: At which ground did Beverley Clulee record their career-best innings (61*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/12.

questions.question: Who took South Africa Women's first-ever ODI five-wicket haul, with remarkable figures of 5 for 7 against Pakistan in February 2008?
questions.explanation: Smith took 5 for 7 in 8 overs against Pakistan at Stellenbosch on 24 February 2008, South Africa's first ODI five-wicket haul.
